Hero_Desc_Suro: A wandering Beastfolk who suddenly appeared in the Beastfolk Village. She prefers learning about others by crossing blades rather than exchanging words. A ronin who travels the world training in martial arts, she wishes to write a heroic tale of her own.
Album_Wish_Suro: To become the greatest in Elias
Album_Suro1: Suro says she came from a distant settlement of scaled Beastfolk. I had heard many rumors that the scaled Beastfolk were sharp-tempered, but meeting her revealed that this was not always true. Perhaps it differs from one individual to another.
Album_Suro2: Because of prejudice, Suro does not get along with Diana, but she seems extremely close with Tig. Whenever they have time, the two travel through the forest together. Even Beni and Rufo, who originally played with Tig, have grown jealous of Suro.
Album_Suro3: Suro is proficient with many weapons and tools. She displayed such talent from a very young age and became a celebrated warrior. Growing up under so many expectations from her people apparently became somewhat burdensome.
Album_Suro4: I found Suro resting in the shade of a tree beside a quiet pond. Upon seeing me, she invited me to fish with her. Suro had tied the line to her rod without a hook so that no fish would be caught.
Album_Suro5: Suro appears quite rational, but when the wrong switch is pressed, she seems to become a troublemaker typical of the Beastfolk. Could this be because Tig is constantly tempting her nearby and leading her into strange behavior? Recently, I have caught the two causing chaos together and scolded them both more often.
Album_Suro6: Diana always glares at Suro with suspicion. Suro accepted it at first, but after seeing that Diana never changes no matter how hard she tries to break down the wall between them, she seems to have reached her limit.
Album_Suro7: Suro no longer remains in the Beastfolk Village or forest. When she needs shelter, she entrusts herself to the Order, and otherwise wanders from place to place. She seems to be suffering greatly, so I am trying to help in every way I can. I hope everything works out eventually.
LoveHero_Suro: An opportunity to train together with you, Master? How fortunate!
LoveHeroCancel_Suro: To wander once again... You must come and find me someday...
Food_ChefNote_Suro_Hate1: She disliked it because she could not digest it. Her deep regret that it tasted truly wonderful was both adorable and pitiful.
Food_ChefNote_Suro_Hate2: She explained that although it looked healthy, it was not to her taste. Apparently, she does not care much for vegetables.
Food_ChefNote_Suro_Like1: Suro liked how delicious it looked before she even began. She swallowed it in one bite and marveled that it was exactly as she had expected.
Food_ChefNote_Suro_Like2: I offered it with considerable doubt, but Suro's eyes began sparkling as though it had completely won her over.
Food_ChefNote_Suro_Like3: Suro ate no fewer than five bowls of deeply savory rice cake soup. When I teased her that this made her five years older, she became slightly sullen.
Food_ChefNote_Suro_Like4: She ate it the instant I served it, then regretted that she had never checked whether it truly resembled a log.
Food_ChefNote_Suro_Like5: When I dissolved it in water, she enjoyed the strange and delicious flavor the water acquired. She also happily ate some without water.
Food_ChefNote_Suro_Like6: Curious about its amusing shape, she examined and played with it from every direction before finally eating it much later. She was delighted by the flavor.
Food_ChefNote_Suro_Like7: Saying the bittersweet flavor kept drawing her back, she finished everything in an instant.
Food_ChefNote_Suro_Like8: She swallowed it in one bite, saying it tasted like fruit concentrated many times over. She liked that it contained every fruit flavor she enjoyed.
Food_ChefNote_Suro_Like9: She liked both its delicious flavor and the pleasure of rolling it around inside her mouth. When I told her that six other flavors existed, Suro was astonished.

LoveLetter_Suro:
Master, this is Suro.

Before anything else, I want to tell you how deeply grateful I am.
When I felt completely alone, lost and struggling within my grief,
you extended your hand to me.
You told me to stay strong, that I was not alone...
Those words raised me to my feet. They helped me endure.

So whenever your own heart becomes weary, please seek me at any time.
I will never forget the kindness I received.

Respectfully,
Suro
LoveCall_Suro:
Hello, Master. It is Suro.
All my Beastfolk friends had work today, and while I sat alone in the forest, you suddenly came to mind.
The day we first met. The many events we experienced. Everything we overcame together.
All of it was possible because you were there, and because you believed in me.
Perhaps that is why, whenever I sit alone and remember the past, your face is always the first to appear.

...Haha. I have grown a little embarrassed while speaking.
But that is all right. I believe feelings like these must be conveyed whenever the opportunity arises.
You believe that too, do you not, Master?
I hope this call has clearly carried both my gratitude and the trust I place in you.

Then I should begin heading back. My Beastfolk friends will return soon.
Thank you for everything, Master. Until next time!
Affinity_Suro_EP01_001: The Beastfolk Village seems to have many pure and kind Beastfolk.
Affinity_Suro_EP01_003: She accepts every errand I ask of her.
Affinity_Suro_EP01_004: Suro is one of those kind Beastfolk too.
Affinity_Suro_EP01_005: I do not dislike such predictable praise.
Affinity_Suro_EP01_007: Hmm? Tig is not a bad Beastfolk.
Affinity_Suro_EP02_001: Who do you think is the strongest Beastfolk, Master?
Affinity_Suro_EP02_002: Beni, after studying hard and becoming clever.
Affinity_Suro_EP02_004: You and Tig are about equally strong, so perhaps whoever wins a fight between you is the strongest.
Affinity_Suro_EP02_005: Is that so? Then we should settle the matter and decide who is strongest today.
Affinity_Suro_EP02_006: You and Tig share first place.
Affinity_Suro_EP02_007: Joint first place... Hmm. Perhaps becoming number one this way would be fine too.
Affinity_Suro_EP03_001: Is there a weapon you handle particularly well, Master?
Affinity_Suro_EP03_002: It is too dangerous, so I keep it at Mayo's pawnshop.
Affinity_Suro_EP03_003: What sort of terrifying weapon could it be...?
Affinity_Suro_EP03_004: My eloquence and broad-minded tolerance are my weapons.
Affinity_Suro_EP03_005: Hmm, perhaps it is too abstract, but I cannot quite grasp that...
Affinity_Suro_EP03_006: I am reasonably skilled with a kitchen knife when I cook.
Affinity_Suro_EP03_007: Large or small, a blade is a fearsome weapon. Impressive.
Affinity_Suro_EP04_001: Which do you prefer, Master, swords or bows?
Affinity_Suro_EP04_002: Bows, of course. They have greater range!
Affinity_Suro_EP04_003: They would be difficult to aim if your opponent darted left and right...
Affinity_Suro_EP04_004: A sword has the advantage if you sprint over and close the distance!
Affinity_Suro_EP04_005: Then running ability is important. I must move quickly before firing the bow.
Affinity_Suro_EP04_006: Strong weapons and weak weapons are merely labels we assign as we please.
Affinity_Suro_EP04_007: That makes me reflect upon myself. I should strive to become the strongest with the weapon I love.
Affinity_Suro_EP05_001: Sparring with Tig is great fun. It is good training too.
Affinity_Suro_EP05_003: Hmm, it is difficult to decide, but am I not ever so slightly stronger? Hehe.
Affinity_Suro_EP05_004: How about settling it with Elias Marble?
Affinity_Suro_EP05_005: The board game? That sounds fine, but I prefer moving my body.
Affinity_Suro_EP05_006: Two evenly matched fighters will improve quickly by competing.
Affinity_Suro_EP05_007: Tig and I are growing together. Perhaps someday we shall both become great heroes.
Affinity_Suro_EP06_002: I prefer mountain climbing to fishing.
Affinity_Suro_EP06_003: Mountains are pleasant too, but I prefer rivers.
Affinity_Suro_EP06_004: I release the fish immediately after catching them. I only do it for amusement.
Affinity_Suro_EP06_005: I see. The fish you catch must quickly feel relieved as well.
Affinity_Suro_EP06_006: I like putting a bare fishing line in the water with nothing attached.
Affinity_Suro_EP06_007: Then it is the time itself you enjoy, rather than fishing. That sounds nice.
Affinity_Suro_EP07_001: I once tried to deflect an axe Beni swung and nearly landed in serious trouble.
Affinity_Suro_EP07_002: It might have been a draw if you had an axe too. Try carrying one.
Affinity_Suro_EP07_003: Hmm, perhaps I should consider carrying an axe as a secondary weapon.
Affinity_Suro_EP07_004: Ask Rufo to fight you next time.
Affinity_Suro_EP07_005: He is the brains of the group, so a one-on-one fight would be unfair!
Affinity_Suro_EP07_006: Beni provides the Feedistance's strength, so she is tremendously powerful. Be careful.
Affinity_Suro_EP07_007: As expected of the Feedistance... What a fearsome organization.
Affinity_Suro_EP08_001: I only stopped by for a moment before setting off again.
Affinity_Suro_EP08_002: Then take out the rubbish on your way out.
Affinity_Suro_EP08_004: Then eat a hearty meal before you leave.
Affinity_Suro_EP08_005: Thank you, Master. I shall not forget this kindness.
Affinity_Suro_EP08_006: You have a nature that cherishes freedom.
Affinity_Suro_EP08_007: I have considered settling down somewhere. Just not yet.
Affinity_Suro_EP09_001: Tig asked me to join the Feedistance... What should I do?
Affinity_Suro_EP09_002: Start at the bottom and work your way up to leader!
Affinity_Suro_EP09_003: Making Tig my subordinate... Would that truly be all right?
Affinity_Suro_EP09_005: They have more honorary members than regular members. That seems a little strange.
Affinity_Suro_EP09_006: That is a dangerous organization. Why not refuse?
Affinity_Suro_EP09_007: How could an organization led by Tig be dangerous? I think you have misunderstood something.
Affinity_Suro_EP10_001: I tried to deflect a stone from Butter's slingshot and was struck in the head.
Affinity_Suro_EP10_002: That slingshot is famously powerful enough to frighten even the Sprite Queen...
Affinity_Suro_EP10_003: Even the Queen? Then I was attempting something absurd...!
Affinity_Suro_EP10_004: A sword is thin, so deflecting it would naturally be difficult.
Affinity_Suro_EP10_005: I heard it was easy for a highly skilled swordswoman...
Affinity_Suro_EP10_006: Why not cut it down instead of deflecting it?
Affinity_Suro_EP10_007: That never occurred to me. I shall remember it during my next training session.
Affinity_Suro_EP11_001: Do you always give to others, Master? Do the Apostles never give you gifts?
Affinity_Suro_EP11_002: I will not refuse if someone wants to give me one.
Affinity_Suro_EP11_003: Next time I visit, I shall bring a gift certain to please you.
Affinity_Suro_EP11_004: That became illegal after Erpin's cake scandal.
Affinity_Suro_EP11_005: The inner workings of those in power are complicated...
Affinity_Suro_EP11_006: Recently I received a monkshood flower sealed inside a glass tube.
Affinity_Suro_EP11_007: What?! Ah, no. That is... a fine gift.
Affinity_Suro_EP12_001: Which is closer to a hero: being born good, or defying an evil nature?
Affinity_Suro_EP12_002: I think I prefer the one whose nature is good.
Affinity_Suro_EP12_003: Is that so...? I suppose that one would be the true hero.
Affinity_Suro_EP12_004: Someone who restrains an evil nature feels more human.
Affinity_Suro_EP12_005: I am not certain what 'more human' means, but even your way of thinking differs from everyone else's, Master.
Affinity_Suro_EP12_006: I do not care which, so long as they please stop causing trouble...
Affinity_Suro_EP12_007: Suhahaha! You are always working hard to manage the Apostles, are you not, Master?
Affinity_Suro_EP13_001: I do not understand why everyone carries only one weapon.
Affinity_Suro_EP13_002: Because the Order tax rises by ten percent for every weapon you carry.
Affinity_Suro_EP13_003: What?! Forgive me, but is there no tax exemption for wanderers?
Affinity_Suro_EP13_004: Why do you carry more than one weapon?
Affinity_Suro_EP13_005: Using only one kind feels stifling. Why turn away when a challenge awaits?
Affinity_Suro_EP13_006: Because drawing you becomes more difficult.
Affinity_Suro_EP13_007: What? I would be grateful if an artist painted me... but I see no reason to worry about that in advance.
Affinity_Suro_EP14_001: What is your homeland like, Master?
Affinity_Suro_EP14_002: Nothing special. It is similar to this place.
Affinity_Suro_EP14_003: Perhaps that is why you adapted so well. I am relieved.
Affinity_Suro_EP14_004: It is not something I particularly wish to remember.
Affinity_Suro_EP14_005: I understand. If I have been discourteous, I apologize.
Affinity_Suro_EP14_006: The World Tree Order is the homeland in my heart.
Affinity_Suro_EP14_007: Hmm... That sounds like an awkward, contrived model answer. Nobody ordered you to say it, did they?
Affinity_Suro_EP15_001: Master, are you perhaps concealing your strength?
Affinity_Suro_EP15_002: Hmm? Why do you think that?
Affinity_Suro_EP15_003: You look far too ordinary for someone with your achievements. I do not mean that as mockery!
Affinity_Suro_EP15_004: If everyone saw my strength, they would all ask me to be their boss, would they not?
Affinity_Suro_EP15_005: Huh? As the Master, are you not already something like the boss?
Affinity_Suro_EP15_006: You have grown close to Tig, and now you speak just like her.
Affinity_Suro_EP15_007: ...Should I be angry? What did you mean by that?
Affinity_Suro_EP16_001: How about holding a dueling tournament in the Order's name?
Affinity_Suro_EP16_002: If there is someone in the Order you dislike, settle it with words.
Affinity_Suro_EP16_003: Do you think I am some thug? I do not fight merely to hit people.
Affinity_Suro_EP16_004: Things like that only leave hard feelings between people.
Affinity_Suro_EP16_005: Is that so? I believe one fierce battle can bring mutual respect more readily than a hundred words.
Affinity_Suro_EP16_006: You use blades, while the Elves will use guns. Are you sure?
Affinity_Suro_EP16_007: Suhahaha! You should worry about the Elves instead. A master never blames her tools.
Affinity_Suro_EP17_001: A wanderer rarely remains in one place. Is there nothing you wish to ask me?
Affinity_Suro_EP17_002: There are so many people calling themselves wanderers at the Order that I am tired of the subject.
Affinity_Suro_EP17_003: Tired of it...? I have so many stories. Please pretend to be curious and ask me just once.
Affinity_Suro_EP17_004: Why detain a traveler who will merely pass us by?
Affinity_Suro_EP17_005: Suhahaha! You understand the romance of a wanderer's life, Master!
Affinity_Suro_EP17_006: When you travel and have nothing to eat, do you graze on grass?
Affinity_Suro_EP17_007: Why would I eat grass?! What? Tig does? What nonsense...!
Affinity_Suro_EP18_001: As we pass through life, there are times when we must set aside our stubbornness.
Affinity_Suro_EP18_002: I wish Tig thought as you do.
Affinity_Suro_EP18_003: Tig will understand eventually, once she gains more experience.
Affinity_Suro_EP18_005: Perhaps the Master should not say that... but I do not dislike such boldness!
Affinity_Suro_EP18_006: And if yielding and enduring still fail to solve the problem?
Affinity_Suro_EP18_007: I hope that never happens... but I cannot say.
Affinity_Suro_EP19_001: Who created this image of snakes as treacherous and sinister?
Affinity_Suro_EP19_002: There is no smoke without fire.
Affinity_Suro_EP19_003: That is too cruel! Shall I begin spreading nasty rumors about you too, Master?
Affinity_Suro_EP19_004: Well, snakes do look like that.
Affinity_Suro_EP19_005: They become cute once you keep looking at them. Ah, no. I did not mean that I am cute!
Affinity_Suro_EP19_006: Managing one's image is always difficult.
Affinity_Suro_EP19_007: I thought I had lived rather diligently... Must I advertise how hard I work?
Affinity_Suro_EP20_001: A hero ought to possess a treasure worthy of her, should she not?
Affinity_Suro_EP20_002: A hero's steadfast will and upright spirit are her treasure.
Affinity_Suro_EP20_003: Wise words. Still, would one or two suitable treasures truly be so bad?
Affinity_Suro_EP20_004: Treasure... I remember hearing something about it somewhere.
Affinity_Suro_EP20_005: Well, tales of heroes and treasure are as common as stones beside the road.
Affinity_Suro_EP20_006: If you find anything like that, return it to the Order immediately.
Affinity_Suro_EP20_007: Uh... Return it? Did the treasure belong to the Order in the first place?
